recommendation: Merge. The Result surface is now the brief's consumer hierarchy with every claim gated on recorded evidence, result-null AUTO outcomes finally have an openable honest home, and the try-again loop preserves intent end-to-end. Follow-ups, in order: (1) when W6 Gap 2 lands and per-event session analyses become real CaptureAnalysisRecords, pass contact/temporalPhasesV2 through the record (the surface already consumes them — zero UI work) and give session events sessionIds so attempt chips light up on the session path; (2) in-app clip playback needs a native/video dependency decision (react-native-video or a PickleVideoPlayback native view) — the replay card's disclosure line and poster degrade honestly until then; (3) AnalyzeScreen's analyzed-phase interstitial (W4 UX) could now hand its record straight to StrokeResult for family/abstention outcomes instead of prose-only — deferred because W4's summary flags that surface as reviewer-signed-off copy; (4) when coach-validated scoring unlocks, implement the reserved §1.5 slot between insight and measured rows (comment marks the exact spot).
risks: contact/temporalPhasesV2 are OPTIONAL structural mirrors on the mobile record shape; no shipped mobile writer populates them yet, so on-device Results today always show the honest 'not established'/no-strip states — the gated rendering is exercised by unit/render tests, not by a real end-to-end mobile record (lab/offline records and future session analyses are the real producers).

The TemporalPhasesV2 type is a hand-mirrored structural copy of swing-lab/src/phaseTemporal.ts (node-only package, cannot be imported) — same duplication class W6 accepted for the proposer; if phaseTemporal's shape changes, this mirror must follow (comment in strokeResultModel.ts points at the pair).

AnalyzeScreen routes its working phase to the analyzing arc via phase.message.startsWith('Measuring') — contained but string-coupled to scoreCapture's two stage captions; renaming those captions silently reverts that stage to the generic orb (visual-only, no logic impact).

ResultScreen demotes the TECHNIQUE SCORE ring below the brief hierarchy (title/replay/insight/rows first). Intended per the brief's consumer ordering, but it is a visible UX change to scored reads that product should sign off on; all scored/training content is preserved verbatim below.

tryAgainFromResult re-declares analysis.shotType for legacy envelope-less records on the assumption that pre-D records were declared-only (true by construction: AUTO shipped with the envelope in the same change); if that assumption is ever violated by an importer, the handoff would re-declare a prediction.

Attempt chips depend on local_shot.sessionId, which today's one-off captures leave null (runCaptureAnalysis sessionId defaults null and AnalyzeScreen does not pass one), so chips rarely appear until a workstream threads session ids — deliberate: grouping is never invented from shotType/time proximity.

The replay scrubber animates a playhead over the measured timeline rather than decoding video frames (no player library exists in the app; adding one is outside W8's file set) — disclosed on-card; treat user confusion reports as the signal to prioritize follow-up (2).
